原文逐行／條款 5.62: Regulatory Risk: Changes in laws and regulations can impact the viability of

原文逐行／條款 5.74: consumer preferences, or broader economic conditions.

原文逐行／條款 5.80: challenges that can affect the project's success.

原文逐行／條款 5.85: claims from investors or other stakeholders. Litigation can be costly and time-

原文逐行／條款 15.57: November 1, 2011. The Company was founded to provide safe, seamless, and
原文逐行／條款 15.59: universal wireless charging equipment and software that can improve the
原文逐行／條款 15.61: efficiency of charging electric vehicles (EV). The Company’s product, the
原文逐行／條款 15.63: Rezonant E8 is an 8kW Level 2 charger is the “only wireless and plug-in
原文逐行／條款 15.65: capable electric vehicle charger in the world”. The Rezonant E8 is the “first
原文逐行／條款 15.67: wireless charger that has met SAE-J2954 specifications and has also
原文逐行／條款 15.68: completed UL-2750 safety testing”. The Company’s headquarters are in
原文逐行／條款 15.70: Brooklyn, New York.

原文逐行／條款 3.19: Opinion
原文逐行／條款 3.22: We have audited the consolidated financial statements of HEVO Inc., which comprise the consolidated balance
原文逐行／條款 3.23: sheets as of December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023, and the related statements of income, changes in
原文逐行／條款 3.24: stockholders’ equity, and cash flows for the years then ended, and the related notes to the consolidated financial
原文逐行／條款 3.25: statements. In our opinion, the accompanying consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all material
原文逐行／條款 3.26: respects, the financial position of HEVO Inc. as of December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023, and the results of its
原文逐行／條款 3.27: operations and its cash flows for the years then ended in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted
原文逐行／條款 3.28: in the United States of America.
原文逐行／條款 3.31: Basis for Opinion
原文逐行／條款 3.33: We conducted our audits in accordance with auditing standards generally accepted in the United States of America
原文逐行／條款 3.34: (GAAS). Our responsibilities under those standards are further described in the Auditor's Responsibilities for the
原文逐行／條款 3.35: Audit of the Consolidated Financial Statements section of our report. We are required to be independent of HEVO
原文逐行／條款 3.36: Inc. and to meet our other ethical responsibilities, in accordance with the relevant ethical requirements relating to
原文逐行／條款 3.37: our audits. We believe that the audit evidence we have obtained is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for
原文逐行／條款 3.38: our audit opinion.
原文逐行／條款 3.40: Responsibilities of Management for the Consolidated Financial Statements
原文逐行／條款 3.42: Management is responsible for the preparation and fair presentation of the consolidated financial statements in
原文逐行／條款 3.43: accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America, and for the design,
原文逐行／條款 3.44: implementation, and maintenance of internal control relevant to the preparation and fair presentation of
原文逐行／條款 3.45: consolidated financial statements that are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error. In
原文逐行／條款 3.46: preparing the consolidated financial statements, management is required to evaluate whether there are conditions
原文逐行／條款 3.47: or events, considered in the aggregate, that raise substantial doubt about HEVO Inc.’s ability to continue as a going
原文逐行／條款 3.49: concern.
原文逐行／條款 3.52: Auditor’s Responsibilities for the Audit of the Consolidated Financial Statements
原文逐行／條款 3.55: Our objectives are to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the consolidated financial statements as a whole
原文逐行／條款 3.56: are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error, and to issue an auditor's report that includes
原文逐行／條款 3.57: our opinion. Reasonable assurance is a high level of assurance but is not absolute assurance and therefore is not a
原文逐行／條款 3.58: guarantee that an audit conducted in accordance with GAAS will always detect a material misstatement when it
原文逐行／條款 3.59: exists. The risk of not detecting a material misstatement resulting from fraud is higher than for one resulting from
原文逐行／條款 3.60: error, as fraud may involve collusion, forgery, intentional omissions, misrepresentations, or the override of internal
原文逐行／條款 3.61: control. Misstatements are considered material if there is a substantial likelihood that, individually or in the
原文逐行／條款 3.62: aggregate, they would influence the judgment made by a reasonable user based on the consolidated financial
原文逐行／條款 3.64: statements.

原文逐行／條款 10.8: NOTE 1— NATURE OF OPERATIONS AND CONSOLIDATION
原文逐行／條款 10.11: HEVO, Inc. was organized under the laws of the State of Delaware on November 1, 2011. The
原文逐行／條款 10.12: Company was founded to provide safe, seamless, and universal wireless charging equipment and
原文逐行／條款 10.13: software that can improve the efficiency of charging electric vehicles (EV). The Company’s
原文逐行／條款 10.14: product, the Rezonant E8 is an 8kW Level 2 charger is the “only wireless and plug-in capable electric
原文逐行／條款 10.15: vehicle charger in the world”. The Rezonant E8 is the “first wireless charger that has met SAE-J2954
原文逐行／條款 10.16: specifications and has also completed UL-2750 safety testing”. The Company’s headquarters are in
原文逐行／條款 10.17: Brooklyn, New York.
原文逐行／條款 10.20: Since November 1, 2011, the Company has relied upon its shareholders and grants for funding cash
原文逐行／條款 10.21: flow to pay for operating expenses (see discussions below). For the period from inception to
原文逐行／條款 10.22: December 31, 2024, the Company has generated losses aggregating more than $23 million. These
原文逐行／條款 10.23: matters do raise concern about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern (see Note 14).
原文逐行／條款 10.26: Principles of Consolidation
原文逐行／條款 10.28: The consolidated financial statements include the accounts of the Company and its wholly owned
原文逐行／條款 10.29: subsidiaries HEVO Europe BV and HEVO Power Limited (collectively, which may be referred to as
原文逐行／條款 10.30: the “Company”, “we,” “us,” or “our”). All intercompany transactions and balances have been
原文逐行／條款 10.31: eliminated in consolidation. The results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2024 and
原文逐行／條款 10.32: 2023 include the results of operations of HEVO Europe BV and HEVO Power Europe Ltd as of their
原文逐行／條款 10.33: respective dates of incorporation.
原文逐行／條款 10.36: Subsidiaries
原文逐行／條款 10.39: The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary, HEVO Europe BV, was registered in the Netherlands on
原文逐行／條款 10.40: May 13, 2015.
原文逐行／條款 10.42: The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary, HEVO Power Limited, was registered in England and Wales
原文逐行／條款 10.43: on September 7, 2017.
原文逐行／條款 10.48: NOTE 2 — SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES
原文逐行／條款 10.51: Basis of Presentation
原文逐行／條款 10.54: The accounting and reporting policies of the Company conform to accounting principles generally
原文逐行／條款 10.55: accepted in the United States of America ("US GAAP"). Any reference in these notes to applicable
原文逐行／條款 10.56: guidance is meant to refer to U.S. GAAP as found in the Accounting Standards Codification (“ASC”)
原文逐行／條款 10.57: and Accounting Standards Updates (“ASU”) of the Financial Accounting Standards Board (“FASB”).
原文逐行／條款 10.60: Use of Estimates
原文逐行／條款 10.63: The preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with accounting principles
原文逐行／條款 10.64: generally accepted in the United States requires management to make certain estimates and
原文逐行／條款 10.65: assumptions that affect the amounts reported in the consolidated financial statements and notes
原文逐行／條款 10.66: thereto. Actual results could materially differ from these estimates. It is reasonably possible that
原文逐行／條款 10.67: changes in estimates will occur in the near term.

原文逐行／條款 11.13: Risks and Uncertainties
原文逐行／條款 11.15: The Company has a limited operating history. The Company's business and operations are sensitive
原文逐行／條款 11.16: to general business and economic conditions in the United States. A host of factors beyond the
原文逐行／條款 11.17: Company's control could cause fluctuations in these conditions. Adverse conditions may include
原文逐行／條款 11.18: recession, downturn or otherwise, local competition or changes in consumer taste. These adverse
原文逐行／條款 11.19: conditions could affect the Company's financial condition and the results of its operations.
原文逐行／條款 11.22: Concentration of Credit Risk
原文逐行／條款 11.25: The Company maintains its cash with a major financial institution located in the United States of
原文逐行／條款 11.26: America, which it believes to be credit worthy. The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation insures
原文逐行／條款 11.27: balances up to $250,000. At times, the Company may maintain balances in excess of the federally
原文逐行／條款 11.28: insured limits.
原文逐行／條款 11.31: Cash and Cash Equivalents
原文逐行／條款 11.34: The Company considers short-term, highly liquid investment with original maturities of three
原文逐行／條款 11.35: months or less at the time of purchase to be cash equivalents. Cash consists of funds held in the
原文逐行／條款 11.36: Company’s checking account.
原文逐行／條款 11.38: Receivables and Credit Policy
原文逐行／條款 11.41: Trade accounts receivable are recorded at the estimated collectible amounts due under contractual
原文逐行／條款 11.42: terms. Trade credit is generally extended on a short-term basis and, therefore, trade accounts
原文逐行／條款 11.43: receivable do not bear interest under normal trade terms. In certain instances, the Company may
原文逐行／條款 11.44: obtain a down payment ahead of providing goods or services to its customers.
原文逐行／條款 11.46: The Company evaluates its accounts receivable for impairment in accordance with the Current
原文逐行／條款 11.47: Expected Credit Losses (CECL) model under ASC 326. This model requires the recognition of
原文逐行／條款 11.48: lifetime expected credit losses at the time the financial asset is originated or acquired. The
原文逐行／條款 11.49: Company estimates expected credit losses based on historical experience, current economic
原文逐行／條款 11.50: conditions, and reasonable and supportable forecasts.
原文逐行／條款 11.52: As part of its credit risk management, the Company routinely assesses the financial condition of its
原文逐行／條款 11.53: customers and monitors outstanding balances. Based on this evaluation, management determined
原文逐行／條款 11.54: that the expected credit losses related to accounts receivable were not material. Accordingly, no
原文逐行／條款 11.55: allowance for credit losses was recorded as of December 31, 2024 or 2023.
原文逐行／條款 11.58: As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Company had gross accounts receivable of $108,430 and

原文逐行／條款 12.20: Prepaid expenses consist of various payments that the Company has made in advance for goods

原文逐行／條款 12.25: Property and Equipment
原文逐行／條款 12.28: Property and equipment is recorded at cost. Expenditures for renewals and improvements that
原文逐行／條款 12.29: significantly add to the productive capacity or extend the useful life of an asset are capitalized.
原文逐行／條款 12.30: Expenditures for maintenance and repairs are charged to expense. When equipment is retired or
原文逐行／條款 12.31: sold, the cost and related accumulated depreciation are eliminated from the accounts and the
原文逐行／條款 12.32: resultant gain or loss is reflected in the income statement.
原文逐行／條款 12.35: Depreciation is provided using the straight-line method, based on useful lives of the assets which
原文逐行／條款 12.36: is three to seven years.
原文逐行／條款 12.39: The Company reviews the carrying value of property and equipment for impairment whenever
原文逐行／條款 12.40: events and circumstances indicate that the carrying value of an asset may not be recoverable from
原文逐行／條款 12.41: the estimated future cash flows expected to result from its use and eventual disposition. In cases
原文逐行／條款 12.42: where undiscounted expected future cash flows are less than the carrying value, an impairment loss
原文逐行／條款 12.43: is recognized equal to an amount by which the carrying value exceeds the fair value of assets. The

原文逐行／條款 12.45: results, trends and prospects, the manner in which the property is used, and the effects of
原文逐行／條款 12.46: obsolescence, demand, competition, and other economic factors. Based on this assessment there
原文逐行／條款 12.47: was no impairment for December 31, 2024 and 2023.

原文逐行／條款 12.53: straight-line basis over the remaining life of the patent (twenty years or less), commencing when
原文逐行／條款 12.54: the patent is approved and placed in service. Trademarks and domain names have an indefinite
原文逐行／條款 12.55: useful life and are therefore not subject to amortization.

原文逐行／條款 13.27: to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed are expensed when incurred.
原文逐行／條款 13.29: Technical feasibility is established when the entity has completed all planning, designing, coding
原文逐行／條款 13.30: and testing necessary to determine that the product will meet its design specifications, including
原文逐行／條款 13.31: functions, features, and technical performance specifications. Once technical feasibility has been
原文逐行／條款 13.32: established, subsequent costs should be capitalized until the software begins to be marketed. As

原文逐行／條款 13.34: software totaling $455,048 and $455,048, respectively.
原文逐行／條款 13.37: Fair Value Measurements
原文逐行／條款 13.40: US GAAP defines fair value as the price that would be received to sell an asset or be paid to transfer
原文逐行／條款 13.41: a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date (exit
原文逐行／條款 13.42: price) and such principles also establish a fair value hierarchy that prioritizes the inputs used to
原文逐行／條款 13.43: measure fair value using the following definitions (from highest to lowest priority):
原文逐行／條款 13.45: e Level 1 - Unadjusted quoted prices in active markets that are accessible at the
原文逐行／條款 13.46: measurement date for identical, unrestricted assets or liabilities.
原文逐行／條款 13.47: e Level 2 - Observable inputs other than quoted prices included within Level 1 that are
原文逐行／條款 13.48: observable for the asset or liability, either directly or indirectly, including quoted prices for
原文逐行／條款 13.49: similar assets and liabilities in active markets; quoted prices for identical or similar assets
原文逐行／條款 13.50: and liabilities in markets that are not active; or other inputs that are observable or can be
原文逐行／條款 13.51: corroborated by observable market data by correlation or other means.
原文逐行／條款 13.52: e Level 3 — Prices or valuation techniques requiring inputs that are both significant to the fair
原文逐行／條款 13.53: value measurement and unobservable.

原文逐行／條款 13.57: 2023.

原文逐行／條款 14.20: Company’s operating expenses. The Company evaluates its lease agreements to determine
原文逐行／條款 14.21: whether a contract conveys the right to control the use of an identified asset and whether it
原文逐行／條款 14.22: qualifies as an operating or finance lease. Short-term leases with an initial term of 12 months or less
原文逐行／條款 14.23: are not recorded on the balance sheet, and lease expense is recognized as incurred.
原文逐行／條款 14.26: Accounts Payable
原文逐行／條款 14.28: Accounts payable are recorded at their invoiced amounts and represent obligations to pay for
原文逐行／條款 14.29: goods or services received. They are classified as current liabilities unless payment is not due within
原文逐行／條款 14.30: one year. Accounts payable are recognized at the transaction date and are subsequently measured
原文逐行／條款 14.31: at amortized cost, which typically equals the original invoiced amount.
原文逐行／條款 14.33: Accrued Expenses
原文逐行／條款 14.35: Accrued expenses represent liabilities for goods or services that have been received but not yet
原文逐行／條款 14.36: paid for as of the reporting date. These include accrued compensation and payroll liabilities,
原文逐行／條款 14.37: royalties, interest on outstanding debt, and other routine operating expenses. These expenses are
原文逐行／條款 14.38: recognized when incurred, based on the best estimate of the amount owed, even if no formal invoice
原文逐行／條款 14.39: has been received. Accrued expenses are classified as current liabilities and are typically settled
原文逐行／條款 14.40: within the normal operating cycle.
原文逐行／條款 14.42: Stock and Equity Based Compensation
原文逐行／條款 14.44: Consistent with US GAAP, the Company records stock-based compensation as a non-cash
原文逐行／條款 14.46: expense.
原文逐行／條款 14.48: The Company measures and recognizes compensation expenses for all stock-based awards,
原文逐行／條款 14.49: granted to employees and directors based on the estimated fair value of the awards on the
原文逐行／條款 14.50: date of grant. The fair value of each stock option award is estimated on the grant date using
原文逐行／條款 14.51: the Black-Scholes option pricing model. The Black-Scholes option pricing model requires the
原文逐行／條款 14.52: input of highly subjective assumptions, including the fair value of the underlying common stock,
原文逐行／條款 14.53: the expected term of the option, the expected volatility of the price of the Company’s common
原文逐行／條款 14.54: stock, risk-free interest rates, and the expected dividend yield of the Company’s common
原文逐行／條款 14.55: stock. The assumptions used to determine the fair value of the awards represent
原文逐行／條款 14.56: management’s best estimates. These estimates involve inherent uncertainties and the
原文逐行／條款 14.57: application of management’s judgment.

原文逐行／條款 15.10: adjusted based upon actual forfeitures.
原文逐行／條款 15.13: Revenue Recognition
原文逐行／條款 15.16: The Company recognizes revenue primarily from the following types of contracts:
原文逐行／條款 15.18: e Product sales - Revenue is recognized at the point where the customer obtains control of
原文逐行／條款 15.19: the goods and the Company satisfies its performance obligation, which generally is at the
原文逐行／條款 15.20: time it ships the product to the customer.
原文逐行／條款 15.21: e Services - Consists of revenues from provision of engineering, installation and training
原文逐行／條款 15.22: services. Revenue from these services is recognized as the services are rendered.
原文逐行／條款 15.23: e Shipping income.
原文逐行／條款 15.26: Shipping and handling activities performed by the Company before the transfer of control of a good
原文逐行／條款 15.27: are fulfillment activities rather than promised services and are included in cost of goods. For
原文逐行／條款 15.28: shipping and handling activities performed after the customer obtains controls of the good, as
原文逐行／條款 15.29: permitted under ASC 606-10-25-18B the company has elected to account for shipping and handling
原文逐行／條款 15.30: as a promised service to the customer. As a result, any amounts received from customers for such
原文逐行／條款 15.31: activities are recognized as revenue and the costs of providing the service are recorded in cost of
原文逐行／條款 15.32: goods sold.
原文逐行／條款 15.35: The timing of the Company’s revenue recognition may differ from the timing of payment by its
原文逐行／條款 15.36: customers. A receivable is recorded when revenue is recognized prior to payment and the Company
原文逐行／條款 15.37: has an unconditional right to payment. Alternatively, when payment precedes the provision of
原文逐行／條款 15.38: goods or services, the Company records deferred revenue until the performance obligations are
原文逐行／條款 15.39: satisfied. As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Company has deferred revenue amounting to $O
原文逐行／條款 15.40: and $29,050, respectively.
原文逐行／條款 15.42: In 2024 and 2023, revenue recognized from deferred revenue performance obligations generated in
原文逐行／條款 15.43: previous periods totaled $0 and $87,670, respectively.
原文逐行／條款 15.46: Grant Income
原文逐行／條款 15.49: Income from government grants is included in “Other income and expenses” on the Consolidated
原文逐行／條款 15.50: Statement of Operations, when it is probable that (a) the entity will comply with the conditions
原文逐行／條款 15.51: attached to the grant and (b) the grant will be received. The grant is recognized as income over the
原文逐行／條款 15.52: period necessary to match it with the related costs for which the grant is intended to compensate,
原文逐行／條款 15.53: on a systemic basis. For the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Company had grant
原文逐行／條款 15.54: income amounting to $0 and $15,000, respectively.
原文逐行／條款 15.57: Research and Development
原文逐行／條款 15.60: The Company currently expenses all research and development costs related to hardware as is
原文逐行／條款 15.61: consistent with industry peers. The company continues to evaluate its research and development
原文逐行／條款 15.62: activities against the guidance in ASC 730-10, Research and Development and may consider
原文逐行／條款 15.63: capitalization of development expenditure in the future should conditions for capitalization be met.

原文逐行／條款 16.19: Income Taxes
原文逐行／條款 16.22: The Company accounts for income taxes under the asset and liability method, as required by ASC
原文逐行／條款 16.23: 740, Income Taxes. Under this method, deferred income tax assets and liabilities are recognized for
原文逐行／條款 16.24: the expected future tax consequences of temporary differences between the financial reporting
原文逐行／條款 16.25: and tax bases of assets and liabilities, and for net operating loss (“NOL”) and tax credit
原文逐行／條款 16.26: carryforwards. Income taxes are provided for the tax effects of transactions reporting in the
原文逐行／條款 16.27: consolidated financial statements and consist of currently due taxes plus deferred taxes related
原文逐行／條款 16.28: primarily to differences between the basis of receivables, inventory, property and equipment,
原文逐行／條款 16.29: intangible assets, and accrued expenses for financial and income tax reporting. The deferred tax
原文逐行／條款 16.30: assets and liabilities represent the future tax return consequences of those differences, which will
原文逐行／條款 16.31: either be taxable or deductible when the assets and liabilities are recovered or settled. Deferred tax
原文逐行／條款 16.32: assets are reduced by a valuation allowance when, in the opinion of management, it is more likely
原文逐行／條款 16.33: than not that some portion or all of the deferred tax assets will not be realized.
原文逐行／條款 16.36: As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Company had no provision for federal or state income taxes
原文逐行／條款 16.37: due to operating losses incurred since inception. The Company has not recognized any deferred
原文逐行／條款 16.38: tax assets related to these losses, as the realization of such assets is not considered more likely
原文逐行／條款 16.39: than not at this time.
原文逐行／條款 16.42: The Company has evaluated its tax positions under ASC 740-10 and concluded that there are no
原文逐行／條款 16.43: material uncertain tax positions as of December 31, 2024 and 2023. The Company does not
原文逐行／條款 16.44: anticipate any significant changes to uncertain tax positions within the next 12 months.

原文逐行／條款 19.22: the periods in which those temporary differences become deductible. Management considers the

原文逐行／條款 24.23: During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company revised its estimation methodology for

原文逐行／條款 24.28: robust and up-to-date inputs for estimating the fair value and recognition timing of equity awards.
原文逐行／條款 24.29: As a result of this change in estimate, the Company determined that the cumulative share-based
原文逐行／條款 24.30: compensation expense recognized as of December 31, 2023, was overstated by $491,318. In
原文逐行／條款 24.31: accordance with Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 250, Accounting Changes and Error

原文逐行／條款 24.33: reversed in 2024 and no prior period amounts have been restated.
